name: Cross-Workspace References
description: Implement a reference system between workspaces. Support shared dependency tracking: when workspace A depends on a library built in workspace B, the system can detect staleness and trigger rebuilds. Support linked projects: changes in one workspace propagate to consumers. Support inherited configuration: child workspaces inherit config from parent workspaces.
purpose: Workspaces are not islands. Real development involves dependency chains, shared libraries, and project families. Cross-workspace references enable coordinated state management — when a library workspace rebuilds, dependent workspaces know about it. This bridges the gap between isolated workspace model and real integration workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-workspace references are stored as (source_workspace_id, target_workspace_id, reference_type, metadata) tuples
Reference types: shared_dependency, linked_project, inherited_config, artifact_source
Shared dependency tracking: when target workspace rebuilds an artifact, source workspace receives a notification
Linked project propagation: config changes in parent workspace propagate to child workspaces
Inherited configuration: child workspaces can inherit config from parent with local overrides
References are queryable: 'which workspaces depend on this artifact?', 'what does this workspace inherit?'
References survive archive/restore and export/import cycles
